root_idea.summary: The root denotes a middle or intervening position, especially as the point of balance, fairness, or equal division.
root_idea.development: From physical centrality and being among or between things, the lexical field develops meanings of moderation, justice, excellence, mediation, central structural parts, and placing or dividing something at the middle.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct supplied Quranic Form I verb group; the inflected QAC lemma is normalized to the perfect citation form وَسَطَ.
Distinct Quranic comparative or superlative nominal use with materially different average and best-ranking senses.
Distinct Quranic adjectival use denoting balanced moderation and justice.
Distinct feminine adjectival form in the Quranic expression الصلاة الوسطى.

senses.definition: To be or become in the midst of a group; to come into the central part of a company.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quranic occurrence, the subject is a feminine plural group understood as becoming amid a company.

senses.definition: The middle or average in degree or quality; moderate between two extremes.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic food provision, it denotes a moderate kind between extravagance and niggardliness.

senses.definition: The best, most excellent, or most rightly directed member of a group.
senses.usage_conditions: In أَوْسَطُهُمْ, the form may refer to the member highest in judgment, age, standing, or general excellence, according to the interpretation of the passage.

senses.definition: Moderate and balanced; conforming to a just mean, and therefore just, equitable, or good.
senses.usage_conditions: In أُمَّةً وَسَطًا, the adjective expresses commendable balance and justice rather than merely a geometric midpoint.

senses.definition: The middle or specially distinguished prayer among the prescribed prayers.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in الصلاة الوسطى. The supplied lexical discussion records differing identifications, including the afternoon, dawn, noon, sunset, and other prayers; it does not establish one identification as exclusive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become in the middle or midst of a place or thing, including the central part of a setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form I positional use with a place or object, distinct from the adverbial وَسْطَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To occupy the best or most honored place or rank among people; to be among the best or most generous of them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of social standing, merit, truth, equity, or grounds of respect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put or place something in the middle or midst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive Form II; the Quranic variant discussion reports this as one possible interpretation of the expression فَوَسَّطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or divide something through the middle into two halves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II resultative use, also reported as an interpretation of the alternate Quranic reading فَوَسَّطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا; the supplied QAC group itself is Form I.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mediate or intercede between people in order to reconcile them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بين and with parties engaged in disagreement, altercation, or litigation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or choose something of a middle sort between the good and the bad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V use concerning selection of an intermediate quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the middle of, in the midst of, or among.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adverbial or prepositional form used for a position between or among things, not ordinarily denoting a component part of the noun that follows; it may occur substantively with فِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle, center, or middle part of a thing: the portion between its sides or extremities, or the portion surrounded on several sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use, especially with solid or unified things such as a house, head, spear, or circle; it contrasts in usage with وَسْط in the adverbial sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Middle, intermediate, or of a middling sort; between good and bad, and in favorable evaluation good, best, or most generous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival epithet applied to persons, things, times, and ranks. Particular examples such as a middle finger, day, night, or set of days illustrate the use without restricting its referent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mediator or intercessor between people, especially between disputing or litigating parties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the person who performs mediation or intercession for reconciliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mediation or intercession between people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used substantively for the act or practice of reconciling parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best or finest dinars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to quality within a set of coins.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means or instrument by which something is achieved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for an intervening means or medium.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forward upright part of a camel’s saddle, the piece nearest the camel’s head and the rider’s breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical saddle term; despite its name, the cited lexical explanation identifies it as an extremity rather than a geometrical middle part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wooden piece between the two side pieces of the yoke placed on a bull drawing a cart or similar vehicle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for a central yoke component.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The central jewel or large pearl in a necklace, regarded as its best or most precious bead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for the prominent central ornament of a necklace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means of doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Identified in the supplied evidence as a modern usage, commonly occurring in the expression بِوَاسِطَةِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intermediary, interposer, or agent between parties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person or agency serving as a go-between.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or comfortable condition of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression هُوَ فِي وَاسِطَةٍ مِنَ العَيْشِ; the evidence marks this interpretation as an assumed figurative development.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part in the middle of a house, tent, or similar dwelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use for the interior middle of a dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cut or divided through the middle into two halves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of something subjected to the Form II division described above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A middle-sized tent made of goat hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized tent term; the evidence describes it as larger than a مِظَلَّةٌ.

cautions: وَسْطٌ and وَسَطٌ are distinct vocalized lexical items: the former is primarily adverbial for a position among or between things, while the latter is a substantive or adjective.
The identity of الصلاة الوسطى is disputed in the supplied lexical evidence; the artifact preserves the disagreement rather than selecting one prayer without sufficient basis.

Lane records an alternate reading فَوَسَّطْنَ with Form II interpretations, while the supplied QAC Quran group is the Form I reading فَوَسَطْنَ; these forms and their meanings should not be conflated.
